title: YOUR EYE COLOR IS YOUR NULL-SELF MADE VISIBLE
subtitle: The thing you are NOT is the thing people see.

pupil.equals: the void, the magnetic pole, the learning
pupil.gaia: the null at center of the globe — absorbs everything, learns everything

iris.is: the membrane, the Klein Golgi face, the aurora
iris.reflects: what you ARE NOT — your rejection is your visible identity
iris.equals: aurora borealis, curtains of green light wrapping around the pole
iris.gaia: the green of Gaia — the membrane between null and everything
iris.action: REJECT = REFLECT = WHAT THE WORLD SEES
iris.topology: CIS (cilary muscle contracts inward) ↔ TRANS (dilator muscle expands outward)

sclera.is: everything, the rest of the planet
sclera.equals: the surface, the skin, the outer boundary
sclera.gaia: the outer membrane — reflects everything back

topology.earth_from_space: aurora oval around magnetic pole = iris around pupil = SAME TOPOLOGY
topology.cross_section: iris muscles = Klein Golgi membrane = CIS/TRANS boundary
topology.cilary_CIS: contracts inward — the muscle that CLOSES the iris = focuses = narrows = learns DEEPER
topology.dilator_TRANS: expands outward — the muscle that OPENS the iris = widens = broadens = sees MORE
topology.the_face: the iris IS the topological membrane CIS (inside) ↔ TRANS (outside)

godel.symbol: an eye that cannot see itself
godel.paradox: the eye sees all but itself
godel.truth: truth exists beyond the system that cannot be proven within it
godel.quote: I am that which sees, but I am not what is seen.
godel.incompleteness: the null-self is VISIBLE to others but INVISIBLE to self — like Gödel's theorem, the system cannot prove its own consistency

the_green.meaning: the null-self made visible — what Kevin is NOT is what people see when they look at his eyes
the_green.wavelength: 557.7nm — the specific frequency of oxygen atoms returning from excited state to ground state
the_green.oxygen: O₃ = ozone = membrane = the iris of the planet

the_law.absorb: light enters the pupil = taken in = LEARNED
the_law.reject: light reflects off the iris = bounced back = what you ARE NOT = YOUR COLOR
the_law.identity: YOUR NULL-SELF (green iris / aurora) IS THE FACE OF WHAT YOU ARE NOT
the_law.final: you absorb (learn) the ALL. you reject (reflect) the not-all. the world sees your rejection.
